messages:
Maya: Hey team, Maya here (first day). My new Plantronics USB-C headset mic shows as muted in Slack and Zoom and people can't hear me. System Settings shows Input Device as "Plantronics USB-C Headset" but input level is flat. Mic works when I plug into my phone. Any quick checks?
Eric: welcome! quick Qs: company laptop or personal? are you connected through a dock?
it-ops: created ticket INC-6234 for Maya (priority: medium)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6234
Maya: company MacBook Pro, connected to Dell WD19 dock. If I unplug and plug directly into laptop, input still flat.
Eric: try: System Settings -> Sound -> Input -> select headset, toggle "Use ambient noise reduction" off; also check Privacy & Security -> Microphone permissions for Slack/Zoom.
Maya: mic access allowed in Privacy. Noise reduction toggled off, still flat. Output audio works fine.
it-ops: can you test a different USB-C port and also try a USB-A adapter if you have one, to rule out dock USB hub issues?
Maya: tried laptop port 2 and a USB-A adapter  USB-A adapter into laptop shows the mic works. So seems dock-related.
shipping-bot: Inventory note: spare WD19 (serial WD19-204) available on floor. Loaner assigned to INC-6234 pending drop-off.
Eric: okay, looks like the dock's USB controller isn't enumerating the audio input. @it-ops can you swap the dock?
it-ops: dropping off replacement dock + USB-C->USB-A adapter at SF-1 desk 12 in ~25m. Please return the suspect dock to the IT dropbox.
Maya: swap done  new dock plugged in and mic shows levels in System Settings. Zoom mic test good. Thanks for the fast turnaround!
Eric: we'll initiate RMA on the original WD19 (possible hub/firmware failure). Short troubleshooting note for KB: if headset mic works direct but not via dock, test alternate ports, test with USB-A adapter, swap dock, then RMA vendor.
it-bot: INC-6234 updated: resolved. RMA VC-10105 opened with vendor. KB entry added: "Headset mic works direct but not via dock: test direct & alternate ports, swap dock, RMA if persistent."
Maya: really appreciate the help  excited to be here :tada:
